name: Xulgath Army

items.name: Club Offensive
items.text:
1 to 3

Frequency once per round

---
Effect The xulgaths make coordinated melee attacks against each enemy in 5-foot emanation, with a DC 21 basic Reflex save save. The damage dealt depends on the number of actions.

1 1d6+1 bludgeoning damage

2 2d6+7 bludgeoning damage

3 2d6+12 bludgeoning damage

items.name: Javelin Barrage
items.text: The xulgaths draw javelins and launch a coordinated barrage at range. This barrage is a 10-foot burst within 30 feet that deals 3d6 piercing damage (DC 21 basic Reflex save save). When the xulgath army is reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a 5-foot burst.

items.name: Rend Flesh
items.text: The xulgaths concentrate their attacks on a single adjacent enemy, clawing and biting with abandon. That creature takes 3d4+5 slashing damage (DC 21 basic Reflex save save). On a failed save, the creature also takes 1d4 persistent,bleed damage.

text: Though most xulgath settlements can be found in the Darklands, these reptilian humanoids sometimes venture to the surface with ill intent. When gathered into an army, xulgaths tear through innocent communities in the name of whatever leader they serve.
